$variant..validate: newData.hasChildren(['h','r']) && newData.child('h').isNumber() && newData.child('r').isNumber() && newData.child('h').val() >= 0 && newData.child('r').val() >= 0 && newData.child('r').val() <= newData.child('h').val()

$order..validate: newData.hasChildren(['id','placedAt','stage','cur','payment','totals']) && newData.child('stage').isString() && (newData.child('stage').val() === 'Awaiting confirmation' || newData.child('stage').val() === 'Confirmed' || newData.child('stage').val() === 'Picking' || newData.child('stage').val() === 'Packed' || newData.child('stage').val() === 'Ready for dispatch' || newData.child('stage').val() === 'Dispatched' || newData.child('stage').val() === 'Out for delivery' || newData.child('stage').val() === 'Delivered' || newData.child('stage').val() === 'Cancelled' || newData.child('stage').val() === 'Returned' || newData.child('stage').val() === 'Placed') && (newData.child('cur').val() === 'PKR' || newData.child('cur').val() === 'GBP') && newData.child('totals/total').isNumber() && newData.child('totals/total').val() >= 0
